name: 53-legacy-settings-screens
description: Settings screens (app: settings) from older files parse and are dropped; the display adds its fixed Settings pages.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    widgets:
      - {type: clock}
  - id: display
    app: settings
    widgets:
      - {type: setting, key: brightness}
      - {type: setting, key: night}
  - id: updates
    app: settings
    widgets:
      - {type: ota, cs: 4, rs: 2}

expect.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    title: a
    widgets:
      - {type: clock}
